desc: Search for records in a LDB database
r: ldbsearch - Search for records in a LDB database

ldbsearch searches a LDB database for records matching the specified expression (see the ldapsearch(1) manpage for a description of the expression format). For each record, the specified attributes are printed.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h</dt><dd>Show list of available options.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-H <ldb-url></dt><dd>LDB URL to connect to. See ldb(3) for details.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-s one|sub|base</dt><dd>Search scope to use. One-level, subtree or base.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-i</dt><dd>Read search expressions from stdin.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-b basedn</dt><dd>Specify Base DN to use.</dd></dl>

LDB_URL

LDB URL to connect to (can be overridden by using the -H command-line option.)
This man page is correct for version 1.1 of LDB.

ldb was written by Andrew Tridgell[1].
